channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Real estate in Indian markets. Today: strong headwind (−3.5).

item.title: [−2] RBI asks banks, NBFCs to tighten API security amid rising cyberattacks
item.description:
Signal: RBI tightening (India). 3 reports from Cityairnews, CNBC TV18, Urban Acres. Related: “RBI Interest Rate Hike May Reshape India’s Housing Market”. Ongoing: also reported on 2 of the previous 7 days (first 12 Nov).

Real estate: headwind (−2) — Home loans get dearer

Why it matters: A higher repo rate lifts loan rates for homes, vehicles and businesses and pushes up bond yields, though it supports the rupee and lenders' margins at first.

Market gauges: Bond market (G-Secs) −2, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1, Growth outlook −1, Rupee +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] Fed’s Waller says central bank may need to ‘shock people’ with half-point rate hike
item.description:
Signal: tighter US monetary policy (US). 12 reports from CNBC, FXStreet, BigGo Finance and 5 more. Related: “Energy-price spillover raises Fed rate-hike risk, former Treasury deputy says”. Ongoing: also reported on 3 of the previous 7 days (first 12 Nov).

Real estate: mild headwind (−1) — Funding costs rise

Why it matters: Higher US rates and yields pull foreign money out of emerging markets, weaken the rupee and push up Indian bond yields.

Market gauges: Foreign investor flows −3, Rupee −1, Bond market (G-Secs) −1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] India Inflation Surge Puts RBI in the Spotlight as Food and Energy Costs Rise
item.description:
Signal: firmer Indian inflation (India). 2 reports from kalkine.ca, mahamedianews. Related: “India's retail inflation rises for 12th straight month”. Turn: earlier readings (14 Nov) pointed the other way.

Real estate: mild headwind (−1) — Rate cuts pushed back

Why it matters: Faster price growth erodes household budgets and makes RBI rate cuts less likely or hikes more likely, lifting bond yields.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −3, Bond market (G-Secs) −1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
